title: Waypoints and Bossbars
description: This pack adds trial mobs, raiders, withers and ender dragons to the locator bar. It also gives trial spawners bossbars. This makes prolonged fights less tedious and can especially be useful during raids if the wave accidently spawns inside a cave.
